defects_argued.quote: Since the aforesaid dictum is applicable in the present facts and circumstances, accordingly, the impugned orders cannot be sustained and the orders dated 22.07.2022 & 14.10.2025 are accordingly quashed.

review.notes: Own challenged order expressly under section 74(9); State admitted no hearing date fixed and this court applied Mahaveer Trading, quashed both orders, and remanded. Quoted precedent dates belong to another taxpayer.
